      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com

      - Persistence::Create or Modify System Process::Windows Service [T1543.003]
      - Execution::System Services::Service Execution [T1569.002]
    examples:

  features:
    - or:
      - and:

            - and:
              - number: 2 = SERVICE_AUTO_START
              - api: advapi32.CreateService
          - call:
            - and:
              - number: 2 = SERVICE_AUTO_START
              - api: advapi32.CreateService
        - optional:
          - or:
            - api: advapi32.OpenService
            - api: advapi32.StartService
      - and:
        - match: host-interaction/process/create
        - or:
          - and:
            - string: /^sc(|\.exe)$/i
            - string: /create /i
          - string: /^sc(|\.exe) create/i
          - string: /New-Service /i
      - and:
        - match: "set registry value"
        - string: /System\\(CurrentControlSet|ControlSet001)\\Services/i

signature_matches.name: get OS version

rule:
  meta:
    name: get OS version
    authors:
      - "@mr-tz"
    lib: true
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
    examples:
      - 493167E85E45363D09495D0841C30648:0x401000
      - 5f66b82558ca92e54e77f216ef4c066c:0x44580A
  features:
    - or:

      - api: GetVersion
      - api: GetVersionEx
      - api: VerifyVersionInfo
      - api: VerSetConditionMask
      - api: RtlGetNtVersionNumbers
      - api: GetProductInfo
      - and:
        - match: PEB access
        - or:

            - arch: i386
            - or:

              - offset: 0xA8 = PEB->OSMinorVersion
              - offset: 0xAC = PEB->OSBuildNumber
          - and:
            - arch: amd64
            - or:
              - offset: 0x118 = PEB->OSMajorVersion
              - offset: 0x11C = PEB->OSMinorVersion
              - offset: 0x120 = PEB->OSBuildNumber
